observation.command:
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev) -o /dev/null -w "app -> %{http_code}\n" https://app.localhost/ 2>&1
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev); echo "caddy ip=$CADDY_IP"
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "app -> %{http_code}\n" https://app.localhost/ 2>&1
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "api -> %{http_code}\n" https://api.localhost/ 2>&1
